outcomeNote: A mishna: three rulings stated, the last of them a tannaitic dispute left undecided here.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁאָכְלוּ כְּאַחַת — אֵינָן רַשָּׁאִין לֵיחָלֵק. וְכֵן אַרְבָּעָה, וְכֵן חֲמִשָּׁה. שִׁשָּׁה — נֶחְלָקִין, עַד עֲשָׂרָה. וַעֲשָׂרָה — אֵין נֶחֱלָקִין, עַד עֶשְׂרִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Three» people «who ate as one are not permitted to divide» and recite Grace after Meals individually; rather, they recite the zimmun together. «And the same» is true of «four» who ate together, «and the same» is true of «five.» However, a group of «six, up to» but not including «ten» people who ate as one, «may divide» into two groups, each reciting its own zimmun. «And» a group of «ten may not divide» into two groups «until there are twenty» people present. The general principle is that a group may not divide unless the smaller groups will be able to recite the same zimmun formula that the whole group would have recited.

segments.he: שְׁתֵּי חֲבוּרוֹת שֶׁהָיוּ אוֹכְלוֹת בְּבַיִת אֶחָד, בִּזְמַן שֶׁמִּקְצָתָן רוֹאִין אֵלּוּ אֶת אֵלּוּ — הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ מִצְטָרְפִין לְזִמּוּן, וְאִם לָאו — אֵלּוּ מְזַמְּנִין לְעַצְמָן וְאִלּוּ מְזַמְּנִין לְעַצְמָן.
segments.en: The mishna states a halakha with regard to two groups joining together: «Two groups that were eating in one house, when some» members of each group «can see each other, they may combine to» form a «zimmun. And if not, these recite a zimmun for themselves and those recite a zimmun for themselves.»

segments.he: אֵין מְבָרְכִין עַל הַיַּיִן עַד שֶׁיִּתֵּן לְתוֹכוֹ מַיִם, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: מְבָרְכִין.
segments.en: The mishna also speaks of the blessing over wine: «One does not recite a blessing over wine until he adds water to it,» that is «the statement of Rabbi Eliezer.» Undiluted wine is too strong to drink and a blessing is inappropriate. «And the Rabbis say:» Since it is possible to drink undiluted wine, one «recites a blessing over it.»

moves.cueHe: שלשה שאכלו כאחת — אינן רשאין ליחלק
moves.summary: Three, four or five who ate together may not divide; six may divide up to ten, and ten only at twenty.

moves.cueHe: שתי חבורות שהיו אוכלות בבית אחד
moves.summary: Two groups in one house combine for zimmun when some of each can see the other.

moves.cueHe: אין מברכין על היין עד שיתן לתוכו מים
moves.summary: R' Eliezer: no blessing over wine until water is added.
moves.about: whether the blessing over wine may be recited before water has been added to it

moves.summary: The Rabbis: one does recite the blessing over it.
